sources.label: Official Stradivarius UK product-page Measurements, Body tab (cm): B11 Japanese-style long sleeve T-shirt
Official Stradivarius UK product-page Measurements, Body tab (cm): Linen-effect flowing shirt

audit: Old /uk/help/size-guide and /gb/help/size-guide 404; no standalone guide. Product-page 'Measurements' > Body tab prints one chest/waist/hip value per size (cm); identical on a long-sleeve T-shirt and a linen-effect shirt (the shirt's XXS button prints '--', so XXS not stored). Letters only: UK/US/EU removed (not printed). Old M 86/67/91 -> chest 90, waist 70, hip 98; old XL 95/76/100 -> 100/80/108; old XS 78/59/83 -> 82/62/90. 'Chest' stored as chest (as for Pull & Bear).
